title: Evergreen Park Elementary School District 124 — claimed by thegentlemen
description: US · Education · d124.org Evergreen Park Elementary School District 124 is a public school district in Evergreen Park, Illinois, a Chicago suburb, serving approximately 1,600 students from preschool through grade 8 across 7 schools. With 150 teachers and an 11 to 1 student-teacher ratio, it holds an 8 out of 10 GreatSchools rating with reading and math proficiency well above Illinois state averages. Led by Superin
